name: Delete metrics stream
description: Delete metrics stream Deletes the metrics stream for the specified workspace. DELETE /v1/metrics-stream/{ownerId}

name: Retrieve metrics stream
description: Retrieve metrics stream Returns metrics stream information for the specified workspace. GET /v1/metrics-stream/{ownerId}

description: Create or update metrics stream Creates or updates the metrics stream for the specified workspace. PUT /v1/metrics-stream/{ownerId}
